== The Emerald City of Oz ==

Mr. Bunn is a resident of Bunbury, a town built entirely of bread and baked goods. He speaks stiffly in defense of his town's identity, telling visitors, "I admit you are all desirable citizens, but the fact remains that our town is called Bunbury." When asked by Dorothy about the ground of the town, he explains, "We dig it out of the ground, which, as you may have observed, is all flour and meal," adding that there is a butter mine on the opposite side of the village. He also converses with another townsman, Mr. Over, asking him directly what he suggests be done.
